items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: Had a fella named, we call him Diage. His name was Robichaud. He was a soft clarinet player but he could play.

ctx.x: Had a fella named, we call him Diage. His name was Robichaud. He was a soft clarinet player but he could play. Who did he play with?
Jack Cary. Why don't you tell me about him too? Robichaud. He was good huh?
